data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons in it now, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50, and let the lake recover to 100. That’s $10,000 each, month after month, if we stick to it. I propose we agree to that equal share and review our catches together each month. John, what do you think?
